summary: Prioritized backlog to prototype a safe, testable Nexus: lattice node control, simulation core, vessel anchor, entanglement channels, energy accounting, security/ledger, telemetry, and CI. MVP focuses on a limited, auditable demo (deterministic simulation + secure anchoring).
assumptions: Prototype is software-first (simulated lattice + virtual crystals) — hardware/physical crystals are out of scope.
Resonance Units (RUs) are an abstract accounting model implemented as a quota system.

must_haves.title: Lattice Control API & Node Model
must_haves.description: Implement core data model for crystalline nodes (stabilizer/tuner/amplifier/attenuator), node state machine, node metadata, and REST/gRPC control API.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: CRUD nodes; attach/detach links; run node state transitions; automated unit tests; API docs.

must_haves.title: Deterministic Simulation Core + Checkpointing
must_haves.description: Deterministic simulation engine (replayable), checkpoint frames, delta compression, immutable storage and rollback API.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: Run deterministic simulation, create checkpoint, revert to checkpoint, validate reproducible replay.

must_haves.title: Vessel Anchor + Command API
must_haves.description: Vessel model that can bind/unbind to nodes, provide telemetry, and accept signed RPC commands (bind, executeFrame, telemetry stream).
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: Vessel can bind to a node, send/receive commands, and produce signed telemetry logs.

must_haves.title: Entanglement Conduit Prototype (channel model)
must_haves.description: Implement logical conduits with metadata (latency, fidelity, coherence-window) and scheduler that maps simulations to conduits.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: Create conduits, assign simulation jobs, measure fidelity/latency metrics in tests.

must_haves.title: RU Energy Accounting + Adaptive Throttling
must_haves.description: Abstract RU model, per-task RU budgeting, throttling/attenuation controls and safety trip; integrate with scheduler.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: RU usage tracked per simulation; throttling enforces limits; automated tests for over-budget behavior.

must_haves.title: Security baseline: spectral identity, RBAC, audit ledger
must_haves.description: Implement identities (spectral fingerprints), RBAC, multi-signer operations for high-impact commands, and append-only signed ledger for audit.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: All high-impact APIs require RBAC; ledger stores signed entries; tests for multi-signer operations.

must_haves.title: Checkpointing, Rollback & Automated Recovery
must_haves.description: Automated rollback to stable checkpoint on anomaly; re-annealing job for nodes.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: Simulated anomaly triggers safe rollback; nodes can be re-annealed.

must_haves.title: Telemetry, Logging & Forensics Hooks (lossless for critical ops)
must_haves.description: Spectral telemetry schema, high-priority lossless channel, checkpoint provenance metadata for forensics.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: Telemetry stream exists, critical events persisted to ledger and are queryable.

must_haves.title: Test harness, CI, and smoke tests
must_haves.description: Unit/integration test harness, reproducible test scenarios, CI pipelines.
must_haves.acceptance_criteria: CI passes for core integration tests; reproducible smoke scenario runs end-to-end.

should_haves.title: Policy Engine & Human-in-the-loop Controls
should_haves.description: Declarative policy rules for permitted experiments, approval flows, and human override UI endpoints.
should_haves.acceptance_criteria: Policy rules enforce constraints; high-risk operations require manual approval.

should_haves.title: Probabilistic / Agent-based Simulation Fields
should_haves.description: Add stochastic simulation layer (Monte Carlo / agent-based) with data export and connection to deterministic core.
should_haves.acceptance_criteria: Run mixed deterministic/probabilistic experiments; checkpoint and analyze outputs.

should_haves.title: Attenuator/Amplifier modules + auto-trip safety
should_haves.description: Dynamic amplifier and attenuator models with hardware/software trip thresholds and automatic cooldown policies.
should_haves.acceptance_criteria: Amplifier trip triggers cooldown and ledgered event; unit tests for edge cases.

should_haves.title: Operator Dashboard (basic)
should_haves.description: Web dashboard for node topology, simulation status, RU budgets, telemetry and approvals.
should_haves.acceptance_criteria: Operators can view topology, start/stop simulations, and approve high-risk ops.

nice_to_haves.title: Vessel mobility & resonance-based propulsion model (visualized)
nice_to_haves.description: Simulate vessel repositioning within Nexus, with visual trace and cooldown modeling.
nice_to_haves.acceptance_criteria: Vessel reposition simulations run and produce telemetry; UI visualization available.

nice_to_haves.title: Automated node annealing & maintenance scheduler
nice_to_haves.description: Background maintenance jobs to re-anneal noisy nodes and reclaim RU inefficiencies.
nice_to_haves.acceptance_criteria: Scheduled annealing reduces simulated noise metrics in tests.

nice_to_haves.title: Narrative/Worldbuilding content pack & art prompts
nice_to_haves.description: Generate story documentation, concept art prompts, and exportable lore for marketing or game-design integration.
nice_to_haves.acceptance_criteria: Content pack delivered with 10 narrative assets and image prompts.

technical_debt_and_refactor_areas.notes: Use a CRDT or distributed-state machine pattern; ad-hoc locking will become costly as concurrency increases.
Separate deterministic core and probabilistic fields into modular services to avoid coupling and scale independently.
Design key lifecycle and safe-storage early; avoid ad-hoc secrets in code/config.

budget_estimate.assumptions: Blended fully-burdened rate = $12,000 per person-month (~21 working days). Adjust to your rate.
budget_estimate.mvp_months_with_recommended_team: ~3 months for MVP (must_haves) with 5 core heads

timeline_and_milestones.total_estimated_duration: 24 weeks (MVP 12 weeks recommended minimal; full scope 24 weeks)

next_steps_recommendation: Confirm scope for MVP (pick which must_haves to start — recommended: start with M1, M2, M6, M9).
Standup a 2-week discovery sprint to produce API contracts, data models, and initial CI skeleton.
Create tracker items (Jira/GitHub issues) from backlog IDs and assign owners.
Reserve security design session (2 days) to define spectral identity and ledger format before implementation.
